about.intro: I'm **Sneh Raunak** - an aspiring software engineer working across *full-stack development* and **AI / ML**.
about.description: I build responsive, dynamic applications and ML-powered product workflows with attention to clear systems and practical problem solving.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Sneh Raunak**, a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student at Chandigarh University (August 2023 - August 2027), with a CGPA of **8.68**.

I completed a six-week Web Development Intern - In-house Training at Chandigarh University from May to July 2025, working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Python, MySQL, Git, and Firebase.

My work combines full-stack development and AI / ML. I build responsive web applications and ML-powered workflows, including Anony Talk and Student Performance Predictor Pro.

I work with Python, C/C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, FastAPI, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Firebase, Git, GitHub, and Google Cloud.
